headline: Why Are Japanese Beer Prices Rising? Four Major Brewers Including Asahi and Kirin Caught Colluding on Prices
summary: Four major Japanese brewers, including Asahi and Kirin, were reported to be colluding on prices. The group reportedly holds a 99% market share and cited raw material costs as the reason for coordinating prices.
why: Asahi and Kirin are Japan's largest beer makers, and they dominate the domestic beer market. Collusion findings can lead to regulatory penalties and reputational damage for the companies involved.
